walkthroughs.body_html:
Theme 3: Communication and the World Around Us — a core area of GCSE French.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Theme 3: Communication and the World Around Us brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Theme 3: Communication and the World Around Us.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: What is the French word for 'Christmas'?
options: Christmas (the English word is used).
Noël (with diaeresis on the ë).
Noel.
Annually.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I am going to visit Paris' (near future) in French?
options: Annually.
Je vais visiter Paris.
Je vais à visiter Paris.
Je vais visite Paris.
Annually.
Actually (in reality).
Currently/at the moment.
Je vais visite Paris.
